title: Gifts for gamers UK 2026: ideas under £20, £50 and £100
description: The best gifts for gamers in 2026 at Black Friday prices: a PS5 pad £42.99, Xbox controller £39.99, GTA 6 £61.85 and a Switch 2 bundle.
intro:
**Our best overall gift for a gamer this Christmas is a spare controller: the PS5 DualSense is £42.99 and the Xbox Wireless Controller £39.99, both at Amazon. Best cheap gift: a 45W power bank for £17.70. Best splurge: the Nintendo Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle at £399.**

Every price below was published on 20 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (19–30 November), so check the product page before you buy. Some Amazon prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.name: Sony DualSense Wireless Controller (PS5)
deals.note: The safest gift for any PS5 owner: pads wear out, and a second one means a friend or sibling can play too. Around £43 is the going Black Friday price, so there's no point waiting. More in our [PS5 Black Friday guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Microsoft Xbox Wireless Controller
deals.note: Works with Xbox Series X|S, Windows PCs and phones, so it suits PC gamers as well as console players. £20 off is a solid saving on the standard pad.

deals.name: Inui 45W 10,000mAh portable charger
deals.note: A pocket power bank fast enough to keep a Switch 2, Steam Deck or phone topped up on a long journey. An easy stocking filler under £20.

deals.name: Grand Theft Auto 6 (PS5)
deals.note: This season's biggest release, and TechRadar calls this the lowest price for a boxed (code-in-box) copy. The Xbox version is £53.85 at ShopTo. It's rated PEGI 18, so it's for adults only.

deals.name: PlayStation Store credit, £70
deals.note: If you don't know which game they want, store credit lets them choose, and here you pay about £9 less than its face value. Make sure they have a UK PlayStation account.

deals.name: Nothing Ear (3a) noise-cancelling earbuds
deals.note: Good noise-cancelling earbuds for gaming on a phone or a Switch 2 on the bus, for £40 off. They connect by Bluetooth, so they're not ideal for fast competitive games, where a wired headset has less lag.

deals.name: Sony WH-1000XM4 wireless headphones
deals.note: Not a gaming headset as such, but excellent noise-cancelling over-ears for travel and handheld play, and over £100 less than the newer XM6. A treat for a gamer who also commutes.

deals.name: Nex Playground motion console
deals.note: A camera-based console where the whole family plays by moving, with no controllers. TechRadar reports a record-low price at Amazon. Some games need a subscription after the trial.

deals.name: Nintendo Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle
deals.note: The console plus a family-friendly sports game for less than the console alone usually costs (£419.99). Very has a bundle with Ocarina of Time added for £449.99. More in our [Switch 2 Black Friday guide](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Best gifts for gamers at a glance

- **Best overall:** a spare controller, PS5 DualSense £42.99 or Xbox Wireless Controller £39.99, both at Amazon
- **Best under £20:** Inui 45W power bank, £17.70 at Amazon
- **Best under £50:** Xbox Wireless Controller, £39.99 at Amazon
- **Best under £100:** GTA 6 for PS5, £61.85 at ShopTo (adults only)
- **Best splurge:** Nintendo Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle, £399 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift for a gamer

The biggest mistake is buying for the wrong machine. Before anything else, find out which console or PC they play on, and whether it's the newest model. A DualSense works with PS5 and PC, not PS4. Switch 2 games won't run on the original Switch. If you can't find out without spoiling the surprise, go for something that works everywhere: earbuds, a power bank or store credit.

Then ask what they actually play. Someone who mostly plays online shooters will value a good headset or a second controller. A Switch owner who plays on the go will get more use from a power bank or a pair of earbuds. Families who play together tend to get the most out of a second pad or a party game.

**Games are the riskiest gift.** Gamers often already own the big releases or have pre-ordered them, and digital copies can't be returned. Store credit (PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo eShop) avoids that, and at Black Friday you can sometimes buy it for less than face value, as with the £70 PlayStation credit above.

**Check age ratings.** Grand Theft Auto 6 is rated PEGI 18. If you're buying for a teenager, look at the PEGI rating on the box. Our [gifts for teenage boys](/guides/gifts-for-teenage-boys-2026/) and [teenage girls](/guides/gifts-for-teenage-girls-2026/) guides have more ideas.

## Good prices to aim for

- **PS5 DualSense:** around £40–45 is a good sale price; the full price is about £60.
- **Xbox Wireless Controller:** under £40 is a good price.
- **Switch 2 bundles:** under £400 with a game included is good value, since the console alone is £419.99.
- **New big-name games:** about £10 under the £69.99 launch price is typical in the run-up to Christmas.

## When do gaming prices drop?

Controller and accessory prices are usually lowest during Black Friday Week, which at Amazon runs to Cyber Monday on 30 November. Consoles tend to be sold as bundles with a free game rather than cut outright. GamesRadar reports that Nintendo's own Black Friday deals start on Sunday 22 November, so Switch 2 buyers could check back then. After Cyber Monday, prices usually creep up until the Boxing Day sales, by which point Christmas has passed. See our [Boxing Day sales guide](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/) and the [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) Black Friday guides.

If you're buying from Amazon, many Black Friday prices are for Prime members. A [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and includes free delivery in time for Christmas.

### What is a good gift for a gamer under £20?

A power bank for handheld gaming, a controller charging stand or a game-themed stocking filler. Our [stocking fillers under £5](/guides/stocking-fillers-under-5/) and [Secret Santa under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/) guides have cheaper ideas.

### Is store credit a good gift for a gamer?

Yes, if you're unsure which games they own. Check it matches their account's region (UK) and platform: PlayStation credit won't work on Xbox or Switch.

### What should I buy a gamer who has everything?

A second controller in a different colour, a good pair of headphones for travel, or a family console like the Nex Playground that they wouldn't buy themselves.

### Will Switch 2 be cheaper on Black Friday?

The console itself rarely gets a straight price cut. The best value is in bundles, where a game is included for less than the console alone usually costs.
